annotations.title: But prooue.
annotations.text: <mn>◦</mn> Though we may not extinguiſh the ſpirit, nor contemn the prophets, yet vve muſt bevvare vve be not deceiued by giving too light credite to euery one that vaunteth himſelf of the ſpirit, as Arch-heretics euer did. vve muſt trie them by the doctrine of the Apoſtles & the Spirit of the Catholic Church, vvhich cannot beguile us.

notes.text: Not rashly to credit every spirit.
